title: Keep every referenced train sequence equal to its interlocking route projection

facts.note: Subject kind is interlocking; the rule covers every train spec that an interlocking route references, whether or not it was edited.
Validator runs in CONFIRM and is confirm-blocking; at CONFIRM every referenced train sequence is checked, including pre-existing mismatches.

Optional, earlier trigger only (not a prerequisite): a diff observer resolving interlocking route -> referenced train_id could warn the planner while editing either side. Absence of an edit does not exempt a sequence.

fires: CONFIRM runs and any interlocking route references a train whose sequence differs from the route projection in step order, intent, from, to or artifact — including mismatches that already existed and were not touched in this change.
Example: a planner edits an interlocking route so its projection now differs from the referenced train sequence.
Example: a planner edits a train sequence that an interlocking route references, without updating the route projection.
Example: a new interlocking route references an existing train whose sequence does not match the route projection.
doesNotFire: A train that no interlocking route references.

A referenced train whose sequence already equals the route projection on step, intent, from, to and artifact (e.g. only prose/metadata differs); any mismatch on those five fields still fires regardless of what was edited.

given: An interlocking route references a train, so the route has a projected sequence and the train has its own sequence.
when: Any referenced train sequence is checked at CONFIRM — whether or not you edited the route or the train in this plan (editing either side is the common way to introduce a mismatch).
then: Make the referenced train sequence equal the interlocking route projection step by step on step, intent, from, to and artifact.
prefer: Change the route and the referenced train sequence in the same plan step so they stay equal.
Compare step by step on all five fields (step, intent, from, to, artifact) for every referenced train before handing off to CONFIRM, including untouched ones.
avoid: Matching only some fields (e.g. same steps but different artifact or from/to) and calling the sequences equivalent.
Editing only one side and leaving the other to drift.
Removing the train reference or editing the validator's expected projection only to get rid of the failure.
why: Guard coverage and the rest of the route reasoning are proven against the route-to-train projection, so a train that diverges from its route breaks that proof. The check is strict and blocks CONFIRM.
evidence: test_sequence_diagram_sanity::test_train_sequence_matches_interlocking_projection passes for every interlocking route that references a train.
Any failure reports interlocking_id, route_id, train_id, step, field, expected and actual; with zero such failures the rule is satisfied.
verifier_detail: Term projection_equivalence: the referenced train sequence equals the route projection by step, intent, from, to and artifact.
Phase CONFIRM, enforcement confirm-blocking; severity 4, disposition strict.
Failure evidence fields: interlocking_id, route_id, train_id, step, field, expected, actual.
audit: Graph context: requires planner.train.interlocking-home (projection equivalence presupposes the homed interlocking); planner.train.interlocking-guard-coverage requires this rule.
